entry_surfaces./: editorial fashion layout — rotating ticker top, sticky luxury nav, full-width editorial hero slider (OUTLET 50%, Lançamento Ibiza, Seleção Superjeans), category visual cards, product carousels (Mais Vendidas, Jeans 50% OFF, Trends), newsletter banner, SEO storytelling footer
entry_surfaces./produtos: catalog split layout — collapsible faceted filter sidebar (categoria, tamanho, cor, faixa de preço, linha) left, responsive 3-4 column fashion product grid right with sort selector
entry_surfaces./produto/:slug: product detail split — high-res multi-angle image gallery left (sticky thumbnails + main image with zoom), purchase panel right (title, reference code, rating stars, price with 6x installments, color swatches, size selector P/M/G/GG with size guide drawer, CEP shipping calculator, accordion details, add-to-cart button)
entry_surfaces./carrinho: cart summary split — cart item line list with qty counter + remove left, order summary panel right with coupon input (GBVIP), CEP calculation, subtotal, and checkout CTA
entry_surfaces./checkout: one-step seamless checkout — customer identification, delivery address, shipping option selection, payment tabs (PIX 5% OFF with QR code simulator / Cartão de Crédito 6x sem juros simulator / Boleto), and order review summary panel
entry_surfaces./pedido-confirmado: order celebration card — verified badge, generated order number, delivery estimate, PIX copy-paste key or card authorization details, item recap, and continue shopping CTA

visual_enhancers.editorial_ribbon: Slow smooth top marquee announcing 'PARCELE EM ATÉ 6X SEM JUROS • CUPOM GBVIP COM 10% OFF • PIX COM 5% DE DESCONTO • FRETE GRÁTIS ACIMA DE R$499'
visual_enhancers.whatsapp_float: Sticky bottom-right emerald WhatsApp support bubble with tooltip 'Atendimento Gatabakana'
visual_enhancers.cookie_banner: Floating bottom glassmorphic LGPD consent banner in Portuguese (BR)
visual_enhancers.free_shipping_meter: Dynamic progress bar in cart drawer: 'Faltam R$ XX,XX para FRETE GRÁTIS (Regiões Sul e Sudeste)'
visual_enhancers.quick_view_modal: Fast preview dialog on product cards with size selection and rapid cart addition
visual_enhancers.search_overlay: Instant live search modal with auto-suggest categories, recent searches, and instant product thumbnails

motion.card_hover: scale-102 with smooth image zoom transition (transition: transform 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1))

accessibility.contrast_standard: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for body and normal copy, APCA validated)
accessibility.aria_labels: All icon-only buttons (cart trigger, search button, wishlist, mobile hamburger, close drawers) have explicit aria-label in pt-BR
accessibility.data_testids: Strict role-based kebab-case testids attached to all buttons, inputs, links, cart indicators, price blocks, and checkout tabs

locale_formatting.installment_text: em até 6x de R$ XX,XX sem juros no cartão ou R$ XX,XX à vista no PIX (5% off)

HeroCarousel: Editorial banner carousel with auto-play, touch swipe, manual indicators, and direct shop CTAs
CategoryTiles: Circular or rounded editorial cards linking to category PLPs
ProductCard: High-fashion card with primary & secondary hover image swap, discount badge (-50%), color swatch dots, quick-add size selector, wishlist heart, formatted BRL price + 6x installments

CartDrawer: Slide-out sheet showing items, quantity modifiers, free-shipping threshold meter, coupon GBVIP applicator, and direct 'Finalizar Compra' CTA

CheckoutPage: Multi-step accordions for Dados Pessoais, Endereço de Entrega (com busca de CEP), Opção de Frete e Forma de Pagamento (PIX interativo com QR code e chave copia-e-cola, Cartão com seletor de parcelas até 6x)

WhatsAppFloatingButton: Bottom-right fixed floating chat trigger
CookieConsentLGPD: Bottom floating cookie warning in pt-BR with accept/reject buttons
instructions_to_main_agent.backend_seed_requirements: Seed at least 16 diverse realistic Gatabakana products spanning all lines (Superjeans, Trendy, Glam, Beachwear, Basic) with realistic BRL prices (e.g., R$ 199,90 to R$ 599,90), authentic product titles in Portuguese, color variants, size stocks, and high-fashion image URLs.
